elements.label: Every note and surprise stays reachable
A. Pinned note holds
elements.detail: crossing a hotspot no longer swaps it
elements.note: While a popover is **pinned**, hovering another hotspot is ignored, so the pointer can reach the pinned note's links.

elements.label: B. Inner note rises
elements.detail: above the Item hotspot of its group
elements.note: A note hotspot inside an Item's hotspot gets `z-index: 4`; others stay beneath Items.

elements.label: C/D. Badge stays clear
elements.detail: of the Surprises panel and Item controls
elements.note:
- Under the panel: moves up above it
- Under 64px tall: drops below the element
- Re-placed when the panel opens or closes

elements.label: D. Escape resets on leave
elements.detail: returning to a note reopens it

elements.label: Browser test: pinned, inner, corner, and short-element cases
